reference.role: Material, thinness and object-category reference; new blank plate composition

prompts.horizontal: Use case: product-mockup. Reference image role: material and object-category reference ONLY. Create a new original asset showing one blank Japanese mahjong dealer/round-wind marker (chiicha marker). This is a THIN ORANGE PLASTIC PLATE, not a mahjong tile. Use the reference to understand the slender rectangular shape, solid orange through its entire thin edge, softly rounded small-radius corners, glossy resin and a gentle specular highlight. No ivory core, no yellow/white layers, no chunky tile body, no raised frame, no decorative border. No lettering at all: the plate must be completely BLANK because text will be added accurately by the game. New composition, one marker only, isolated on genuinely transparent background with padding, no cloth or table, no logos or watermark. Photorealistic studio product-photo texture. Light from upper left. A tiny dark contact shadow may sit immediately below. The real object is approximately 55mm long, 25mm wide and 6mm thick; make its thinness convincing. Keep the entire silhouette visible. Orientation: long axis perfectly horizontal across the image, orthographic view from slightly elevated straight-on camera; no yaw or sideways skew, both short ends at same height. The projection is approximately 92 units wide by 36 units tall including about 3 units of thin visible orange edge below. The dominant broad upper face must be flat orange, broad soft reflection away from its center so black text will remain readable. Do not add markings.
